data.exact_reserve_text: In the financial year there was prior accident year favourable development of claims incurred of $6.3 million (2021: $5.3 million adverse). There was limited claims movement on our closed years (2009-2019), primarily from improvements on the 2019 year of account offset by deterioration on the 2017 year. The result on the closed years for financial year 2022 was a profit of $2.7m. The result on the 2020 year for financial year 2022 was a loss of $4.5m. The result for the 2021 year for the financial year 2022 is a profit of $39.4m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant gross release of $266.8 million in prior year reserves, representing a 47.5% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding. This gross release contrasts with a reported net favourable development of $6.3 million for prior accident years. The net results for specific underwriting years in 2022 showed a profit of $2.7 million for closed years (2009-2019), a loss of $4.5 million for the 2020 year, and a profit of $39.4 million for the 2021 year. The 2020 year was affected by COVID-19 losses, particularly in the Contingency class, although the net impact was removed by an LPT agreement. Favourable claims development on catastrophe losses from Hurricane Laura and winter storms contributed to positive outcomes in the 2021 year.

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development figure is calculated from the gross claims development triangle, which shows a significant release. This contrasts with the net prior year development figure of $6.3 million stated in the narrative, and the sum of net year-of-account results for prior years ($37.6 million release). The gross figure from the triangle is used as per instructions.
